parameters.name: CredentialConfig
parameters.description: The chained authorization configuration. This parameter is optional. For more information, see [Use chained authorization to access resources of other entities](~~465340~~).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The frame capture frequency. This parameter is used for GIF and long image detection. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: MaxFrames
parameters.description: The maximum number of frames to capture. This parameter is used for GIF and long image detection. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The notification configuration. For more information about the format of asynchronous notification messages, see [Asynchronous notification message format](~~2743997~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For more information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: SourceURI
parameters.description:
The OSS URI of the image.

The URI must follow the `oss://<Bucket>/<Object>` format. `<Bucket>` is the name of the OSS bucket that is in the same region as the project. `<Object>` is the full path of the file, including the file name extension.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The custom tags. You can use tags to search for and filter asynchronous tasks.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom information. This information is returned in the asynchronous notification message to help you associate the message with your system. The value can be up to 2,048 bytes long.
